_about: Nathaniel Hawthorne's (1804-1864) books for children, the storyteller's shelf: the two Greek-myth books (A Wonder-Book, Tanglewood Tales), the New England history told round Grandfather's Chair, and the Biographical Stories. His novels and adult tales are not on this shelf; that is Adam's call. Clean Gutenberg text; published before 1930: US public domain.

hawthorne-wonder-book: A Wonder-Book for Girls and Boys (1851), ill. Walter Crane
hawthorne-grandfathers-chair: The Whole History of Grandfather's Chair (1841)
hawthorne-biographical-stories: Biographical Stories (1842), from True Stories of History and Biography

_excluded.hawthorne-duplicates: A Wonder Book and Tanglewood Tales (PG 35377, Parrish ill., both books in one file), Tanglewood Tales (PG 51995, Sterrett ill.), and the single Wonder-Book tales (PG 9255-9258): texts held
_excluded.hawthorne-not-this-shelf: PENDING, outside this storytellers shelf unless Adam widens it: the novels (Scarlet Letter, Seven Gables, Blithedale, Marble Faun, Fanshawe), Twice-Told Tales, Mosses from an Old Manse, The Snow-Image and the single-story Gutenberg files cut from them (PG 9201-9245), notebooks
